name: Happy Canyon of Santa Barbara

known.article: Happy Canyon of Santa Barbara AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "Happy Canyon of Santa Barbara AVA"

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Wind, altitude and day-night swings of up to ⟦temp|50°F|28°C⟧ give wines a cooler personality than you might expect.
Cabernet Sauvignon can be ripe without being jammy, or show savory herb and mineral notes.
Sauvignon Blanc ranges from ripe tropical and stone fruit to tart citrus, grass and pepper.

blurb.text: A Santa Ynez Valley sub-area in Santa Barbara County, made of canyon, hills and creek basins east of the San Rafael Mountains.
